au-f2006l01279.summary: ADR 28/01 limits external vehicle noise for LE, M and N vehicles; vehicles complying with ADR 83/00 need not comply. UN R51/01 or 51/02 is accepted subject to ADR stationary-noise requirements; for goods vehicles and omnibuses it is equivalent only for moving-vehicle tests, with separate stationary-test evidence required.

au-f2006l01450.summary: ADR 58/00 specifies construction requirements for M2 and M3 omnibuses designed for, and intended for licensing for, hire and reward. For small omnibuses carrying up to 15 persons including the driver, UN R52 (01 series) is an alternative; UN R107 (02–05 series) additionally requires compliance with ADR clauses 58.23 and 58.24.
au-f2006l01450._why_summary: F013: regulations/au-f2006l01450.md — Function and scope and M2/M3 applicability table; alternatives 4.1–4.2 limit small omnibuses to 15 persons including driver, with R107 also requiring 58.23 and 58.24.

au-f2006l01785.summary: ADR 11/00 sets injury-reduction and energy-absorption requirements for internal sun visors and attached mirrors. It applies to M1 passenger vehicles, LEP/LEG motor tricycles, light omnibuses up to 4.5 tonnes GVM, light goods vehicles and NB1 medium goods vehicles up to 4.5 tonnes, from the dates in its applicability table.

au-f2006l02299.summary: ADR 63/00 specifies additional requirements for trailers used in road trains with a gross combination mass not exceeding 125 tonnes. It applies to the trailer categories and manufacturing dates in its applicability table and covers electrical and mechanical requirements. Pig trailers other than converter dollies must not be approved to this rule.
au-f2006l02299._why_summary: F122: regulations/au-f2006l02299.md — Function and scope sets road-train gross combination mass not exceeding 125 tonnes; applicability table and electrical/mechanical requirements apply; pig trailers other than converter dollies must not be approved.

au-f2006l02305.summary: ADR 77/00 prescribes photometric requirements for motor vehicle headlamps equipped with gas discharge light sources. Fitment is governed by ADRs 13, 19 and 67. Required headlamps must comply with Appendix A as varied by the exemptions and supplementary requirements, or the alternative technical requirements of UN Regulation No. 98.
au-f2006l02305._why_summary: F123: regulations/au-f2006l02305.md — Function and scope specifies photometric gas-discharge headlamp requirements; applicability refers fitment to ADRs 13/19/67; requirements, exemptions and alternative technical requirements expressly identify UN R98.

au-f2006l02308.summary: ADR 74/00 prescribes photometric requirements for side marker lamps to increase visibility of the sides of road vehicles. Fitment is governed by ADRs 13, 19 and 67. Compliance may use the modified Appendix A or the rule’s alternative side-marker requirements; UN Regulation No. 91, 00 series, is also deemed equivalent.
au-f2006l02308._why_summary: F124: regulations/au-f2006l02308.md — Function and scope and applicability specify side-marker photometry and ADRs 13/19/67 fitment; requirements/alternatives and clause 6 accept modified Appendix A or alternative provisions and UN R91/00.

au-f2006l02312.summary: ADR 66/00 regulates seat, seat-anchorage and seatbelt-anchorage strength and occupant protection from seat accessories in specified M2 and M3 omnibuses. It excludes route service omnibuses, omnibuses with fewer than 17 seats including driver and crew, and vehicles whose passenger seats all have a reference height below 1.0 m. Omnibuses complying with ADR 68 need not comply. It incorporates ECE Regulation 80 requirements with modifications.
au-f2006l02312._why_summary: F125: regulations/au-f2006l02312.md — Function and scope; B.1–B.2 and table C apply to MD3/MD4 (M2) and ME (M3) subject to route-service, fewer-than-17-seat and reference-height exclusions; B.3 exempts ADR68-compliant omnibuses; 66.2.1–66.2.2 incorporate modified ECE R80. Scope wording modified as explicitly authorized by root after re-checking the table.

au-f2017l01214.summary: ADR 31/04 prescribes braking requirements for MA, MB, MC and NA vehicles and certain LEP motor tricycles. It is mandatory for new models from 1 July 2019; other models may continue to comply with ADR 31/03. UN Regulation No. 13-H (01 series) is deemed equivalent.

au-f2017l01221.summary: ADR 89/00 requires Brake Assist Systems on MA, MB, MC and NA vehicles to maximise emergency braking performance. It is mandatory for new models from 1 July 2019; other models may continue to comply with ADR 31/03 or ADR 35/05 as applicable. UN Regulation No. 139 (00 series) is deemed equivalent for vehicles equipped with BAS.
au-f2017l01221._why_summary: F130: regulations/au-f2017l01221.md — Function and scope and applicability clauses cover BAS for MA/MB/MC/NA; new models from 1 July 2019, other models continuing ADR31/03 or ADR35/05; alternative standards accepts R139/00 for BAS-equipped vehicles.

au-f2017l01229.summary: ADR 88/00 requires Electronic Stability Control on MA, MB, MC and NA vehicles to reduce crashes involving loss of directional control. It is mandatory for new models from 1 July 2019; other models may continue under ADR 31/03 or ADR 35/05 as applicable. UN Regulation No. 140 (00 series) and GTR No. 8 are alternative standards, subject to the stated exemptions.
au-f2017l01229._why_summary: F131: regulations/au-f2017l01229.md — Function and scope and applicability clauses cover ESC for MA/MB/MC/NA; new models from 1 July 2019, other models continuing ADR31/03 or ADR35/05; alternative standards lists R140/00 and GTR8 with exemptions.

au-f2018l00692.summary: ADR 38/05 specifies normal and emergency braking requirements for trailers with Gross Trailer Mass exceeding 750 kg, excluding trailers designed for towing vehicles with maximum speed below 50 km/h. It applies to new models from 1 July 2019 and all applicable trailers from 1 November 2019. Compliance may be demonstrated by road tests or calculations using approved component data.

au-f2018l01513.summary: ADR 94/00 requires audible warning devices on category L, M and N vehicles. It is mandatory for new models from 1 July 2019; other models may continue to comply with ADR 42/04. UN Regulation No. 28 (00 series) is deemed equivalent for categories LC, LD, LE, M and N.

au-f2018l01515.summary: ADR 90/00 specifies steering safety under normal operating and failure conditions for category LB, LD, LE, M and N vehicles. It is mandatory for new models from 1 July 2019; other models may continue to comply with ADR 42/04. UN Regulation No. 79 (01 to 02 series) is deemed equivalent for category M and N vehicles.
au-f2018l01515._why_summary: F136: regulations/au-f2018l01515.md — Function/scope and applicability cover normal/failure steering safety for LB/LD/LE/M/N, new models from 1 July 2019 and ADR42/04 continuation for others; alternative standards makes R79 series01–02 equivalent for M/N.

br-contran-949.summary: CONTRAN 949/2022 sets side-barrier and pole-impact protection for specified cars, vans, pickups and utility vehicles. Barrier scope depends on seat R-point height; pole scope has mass or pickup-geometry conditions and listed exemptions. Barrier requirements phase in in 2020/2024 and pole requirements in 2026/2030. Applicable UN or North American test results are alternatives; pole tests expressly accept UN R135 or FMVSS 214.
br-contran-949._why_summary: F170: regulations/br-contran-949.md — Articles2§1 and3§1 qualify barrier/pole vehicle scope; Article4 lists exemptions; Article5 phases barrier requirements2020/2024 and pole requirements2026/2030; Articles2§2/3§2 accept alternatives, with pole tests naming UN-R135 and FMVSS214.

br-contran-954.summary: Requires ESC for new M1/N1 vehicles, allowing VSF for N1 and M1 above 1,735 kg running-order mass. Directional and roll VSF applies to M2/M3/N2 and specified N3 configurations; roll VSF applies to O3/O4 with one to three axles. Exclusively urban M3 fitment is optional except school vehicles. Vehicle exemptions and phased dates apply; applicable UN R13-H/R13/R140 or FMVSS 126 test results demonstrate performance.
br-contran-954._why_summary: F171: regulations/br-contran-954.md — Article3§§1–6 requires ESC/VSF with running-order-mass threshold, N3/O3/O4 configuration limits and urban-M3/school distinction; Articles6–7 provide exemptions/dates; Article4 names ECE R13-H/R13/R140 or FMVSS126 as applicable.

br-contran-970.summary: CONTRAN 970/2022 sets technical specifications for vehicle lighting and signalling, including special lamps. It covers cars, trucks, buses, trailers and semi-trailers, plus motorcycles, mopeds, tricycles and quadricycles under separate annexes. UN/UNECE or FMVSS test results may demonstrate applicable performance requirements. Entered into force 1 July 2022.
br-contran-970._why_summary: F175: regulations/br-contran-970.md — Article1 covers lighting/signalling and special lamps; Articles3–4 list ordinary vehicles and motorcycles/mopeds/tricycles/quadricycles under separate annexes; Article14 accepts applicable UNECE/FMVSS results; Article21 sets1July2022 commencement.

br-mover-rota-2030.summary: Government news article about Decree 12.435/2025 regulating the MOVER program. It reports technical and environmental parameters for vehicle makers and importers, including energy efficiency and recyclability, with commercialization requirements from June 2025. This record holds the announcement, rather than the decree text; consult the linked Official Gazette decree for legal requirements.
